desc: A Persian man in his early thirties with a natural standard Tehrani accent. Rich, resonant, smooth mid-low voice, clear and comforting like a premium audiobook narrator, warm and confident. Expressive storytelling intonation: it rises with tension and drops to an intimate hush in scary moments. Steady medium pace, crisp articulation, realistic breathing. Avoid harsh bass, gravel, news-anchor tone and movie-trailer voice.
text: روز دهم. زمین زیر تنت می‌لرزه. خاک از سقف تونل می‌ریزه روی صورتت. بیرون، آسمون رنگ آتیشه. و دم ورودی، یه چیز خیلی بزرگ داره نفس می‌کشه.
